title: Gradio analytics are on
explanation: Gradio sends usage analytics to Gradio's servers unless GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED is set to something other than "True". Its own guide is inconsistent about the default, but the API docs and source enable analytics when the variable is unset.

evidence.detail: gradio 5.4.0 installed; not disabled in the image (none of GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=!true)

fix: Set GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=False in the image environment (and analytics_enabled=False in code).
